title: Creamy White Bean Casserole
description: A comforting and flavorful gluten-free casserole made with slow-cooked white beans, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
3. Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
4. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the diced tomatoes, cream of mushroom soup, and cooked white beans to the skillet. Stir to combine.
6. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture and shredded cheddar cheese.
7. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.
8. Add the ground beef and bean mixture to the prepared baking dish.
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
